subject: Re: SummitCo GCP private offer drawdown — staggered redemption plan
messages:
From: Asha Patel <asha.patel@summitco.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Chris Lang <chris.lang@summitco.com>, gcp-marketplace@google.com
Date: Sun, 28 Mar 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Initial: SummitCo private offer drawdown sequencing

Kimberly — thanks for the call this morning. Per our procurement team, SummitCo needs a proposal that staggers redemption across Q2/Q3 to match our cashflow and invoice calendar. High level asks: 

- Can Redwood break the private offer into three tranches (May, July, Sept)?
- Provide invoice trigger dates and any front-loading penalties (if applicable).
- Confirm whether each tranche can be associated with a separate invoice/PO number and whether usage can be reported per tranche.

I attached our preferred cadence template (we use it for other ISVs). Once we have a draft schedule we can route to finance for sign-off.

Thanks,
Asha
Asha Patel
Sourcing Manager, SummitCo
asha.patel@summitco.com
+1 415-555-0191

Attachment: SummitCo_PrivateOffer_StaggeredSchedule_v1.xlsx

From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Asha Patel <asha.patel@summitco.com>
Cc: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, gcp-marketplace@google.com
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial: SummitCo private offer drawdown sequencing

Asha — appreciate the clear asks. Jon and Marissa and I reviewed internally; quick summary of constraints and options: 

1) Tranching: we can map the private offer to three redemption windows. Each tranche becomes a scheduled redemption in GCP Marketplace (we'll create three line items under the same private offer ID).

2) Invoicing: GCP will still generate a single billing relationship per private offer, but we can annotate invoices with tranche PO numbers — Chris can allocate the ledger lines on his side. We will confirm the exact invoice fields with the marketplace team.

3) Cost/penalty: there is no platform-level "front-loading penalty" from Redwood. If SummitCo wants to accelerate redemption earlier than the schedule, you may consume credit faster but there is no additional fee. If you ask for a frontload credit (move dollars forward), that's a commercial ask we can route to RevOps.

Next steps: 
- Jon to draft the tranche schedule in Redwood's template and align with GCP Marketplace invoice fields.
- Marissa to confirm co-sell crediting and any marketplace SKU mapping implications.
- Kimberly to provide a clean private-offer worksheet back to you by EOD Thursday.

Sound good?

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Director, Strategic GTM
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

Subject: RE: SummitCo private offer drawdown sequencing — invoice fields and technical constraints

Kimberly/Asha — following up from internal ops: 

- We can accept up to three scheduled redemptions tied to the same private offer ID. Each redemption will produce a distinct consumption record, and we can populate an "externalPO" field per redemption to carry your PO# metadata. This should satisfy SummitCo's request for PO-level reconciliation.
- The marketplace invoice will be consolidated under SummitCo's billing account; however, our exported ledger (CSV) will include the externalPO field allowing Accounting to split lines.
- For co-sell meta: please provide the exact SKU mapping used by Redwood so we can ensure partner crediting runs correctly.

No platform penalties for staggering. If SummitCo needs funds to be drawn earlier we recommend the customer request an accelerated redemption from within their GCP Console or work with you to amend the schedule and run a single early redemption.

Regards,
GCP Marketplace Ops
marketplace-ops@google.com
